title: 第二章 若我不傻，你亦没病
content_zh:
“啊？没……没有。”

    任天一看着白婧忧郁的眼神，心中竟生出了前所未有的保护欲，前世他一心丹道，无心情欲，这一刻，眼前的弱女子的一举一动却牵挂着他的心，竟在他的心里荡起了涟漪。

    “我的样子吓到你了吧？”

    白婧双臂抱膝垂下眼帘，落寞的说道，她认为任天一发愣是被自己的相貌吓到了。

    任天一看在眼里，不禁哑然失笑，显然白婧很是在意自己的相貌，但任天一清楚白婧脸上的胎记，是她的体质给她带来的副作用，只要她掌握了玄阴凤体的能量，这胎记将会不治自愈。

    “怎么可能？在本帝眼中，你是最美的。”任天一收起笑容，颇为认真的说道。

    白婧抬眸，满脸的难以置信，不由一阵失神，觉得眼前的任天一让她有种不一样的感觉，随后苦涩道：“我差点就信了你的话，看来外界的传言是真的了，不过我不会嫌弃你痴傻，毕竟我也没有多少日子可活了。”

    “痴傻？本帝痴傻？”任天一被白婧的话逗乐了，同时也明白了为什么肉身的记忆空空如也了。

    原来任天一是个傻子。

    “你是知道的，原本和你指腹为婚是萱妹妹，父亲不愿意萱妹妹的一辈子就这么毁了，才让我这个时日不多的人与你成亲的，而你父亲也是同意的。”

    “如今星落城各家族间的纷争愈演愈烈，白任两家联姻也是迫不得已，唉，说了你也不懂。”

    “好吧，薄命女嫁痴傻郎，这两家的诚意也十足啊。”任天一忍不住的调侃了一句。

    “我既然嫁了你，我会认命，会好好和你把余下的日子走完。”白婧认真地说道。

    “认命？”

    此时，天色依然大亮，白婧身体也慢慢恢复了过来，脸上也有了血色，只是那眉宇间的忧郁之色挥之不去。

    “倘若我不傻你亦没病，你将如何打算？”原本已经走下床榻的任天一，忽然回首问道。

    白婧不由一阵摇头苦笑：“你先天绝脉又痴傻，我天生身患绝症，这是我们的命……倘若你不傻，我没病……”

    “嗯……”任天一一脸期待。

    “执子之手与子偕老，这未免太过俗套了，奈何我这一生又太过短暂，还没来得及领略生命的意义就要走到尽头了。若是有倘若，小女子希望随君天涯，逍遥人生。”白婧还是极为憧憬的回答道。
content_en:
"Huh? No...no."

    When Ren Tianyi looked at Bai Jing's melancholy eyes, he felt an unprecedented desire for protection in his heart. In his previous life, he was focused on alchemy and not on lust. At this moment, every move of the weak woman in front of him worried about his heart and actually caused ripples in his heart.

    "Does my appearance scare you?"

    Bai Jing hugged her knees and lowered her eyes, and said in a lonely voice. She thought Ren Tianyi was stunned because he was frightened by her appearance.

    Ren Tianyi couldn't help but laugh when he saw it. It was obvious that Bai Jing cared about her appearance, but Ren Tianyi knew that the birthmark on Bai Jing's face was a side effect of her constitution. As long as she mastered the energy of the Xuanyin Phoenix Body, the birthmark would heal itself without treatment.

    "How is it possible? In the eyes of this emperor, you are the most beautiful." Ren Tianyi put away his smile and said seriously.

    Bai Jing raised her eyes, her face filled with disbelief. She couldn't help but lose consciousness for a while. She felt that the Ren Tianyi in front of her made her feel something different. Then she said bitterly: "I almost believed you. It seems that the rumors from the outside are true, but I will not dislike you for being stupid. After all, I don't have many days left to live."

    "Stupid? I am stupid?" Ren Tianyi was amused by Bai Jing's words, and at the same time he understood why the memory of the physical body was empty.

    It turns out that Ren Tianyi is a fool.

    "You know that it was Sister Xuan who was originally married to you. My father didn't want Sister Xuan's life to be ruined like this, so he allowed me, a person who has only a short time to live, to marry you, and your father also agreed."

    "Nowadays, the disputes among the families in Xingluo City are getting more and more intense, and the Bai Ren family has no choice but to marry. Alas, even if I tell you, you don't understand."

    "Well, if a poor girl marries an idiot, these two families are very sincere." Ren Tianyi couldn't help but tease.

    "Since I married you, I will accept my fate and spend the rest of my life with you." Bai Jing said seriously.

    "Resign yourself to your fate?"

    At this time, the sky was still bright, Bai Jing's body was slowly recovering, and her face had color, but the melancholy between her eyebrows lingered.

    "If I'm not stupid and you're not sick, what are you going to do?" Ren Tianyi, who had already walked out of bed, suddenly looked back and asked.

    Bai Jing couldn't help but shook her head and smiled bitterly: "You were born with no pulse and you are stupid. I was born with a terminal disease. This is our fate... If you are not stupid, I am not sick..."

    "Well..." Ren Tianyi looked expectant.

    "It's too cliched to hold your hand and grow old together with me. However, my life is too short. It will come to an end before I have time to appreciate the meaning of life. If anything happens, the little girl hopes to follow you to the end of the world and live a happy life." Bai Jing replied with great longing.
title_en: Chapter 2 If I’m not stupid, you’re not sick either
